usage.title: Cherry Flash usage terms
usage.subtitle: A low-cost subscription to open-source models for everyday office work.

intro.title: What Cherry Flash is
body: Cherry Flash is a low-cost subscription that gives you steady access to a curated set of open-source Flash models — for writing, summarising, translation, data work, drafting email and taking meeting notes. Your subscription price is shown at sign-up.

It works like any other model provider. Once you subscribe, the models show up in Cherry Studio’s model selector — there is no API key to configure. It is entirely optional and is not required to use any of our products.
It is designed to be used inside Cherry Studio, where it provides steady model access for everyday office tasks.

background.title: Why we built it
body: Open-source models have become genuinely capable. On everyday office tasks, Flash-class models now perform close to proprietary ones — and because many providers can serve them competitively, they usually cost far less.
Reliable, low-latency access is the hard part. Providers vary widely in both quality and availability.
steps: Tested a curated set of open-source Flash models, and talked to the teams behind them about how best to run each one.
Worked with a number of providers to make sure those models are served correctly.
Benchmarked the model-and-provider combinations, and settled on a shortlist.

how.title: How to use it
body: Once you subscribe, open the model selector in Cherry Studio and pick any model served by the Cherry AI provider. Nothing else to set up.
how.callout: Personal use only. Commercial use is not permitted.

limits.title: Usage limits
limits.intro: Rates are in USD per million tokens. All included models share one monthly allowance. The amount in each row shows how much usage is included if you use only that model for the entire billing month.
limits.peak_note: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash peak hours are Monday to Friday, 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC. Off-peak rates apply at all other times, including weekends. Qwen and GLM rates are the same at all hours.
limits.console: You can track your current usage in the console.
limits.change: Limits may change as we learn from early usage and feedback.

overage.title: When your allowance runs out
overage.body: Once you use up the shared monthly allowance, access to the included models through Cherry Flash stops for the rest of that billing period. You can keep using Cherry Studio with your own model provider API key.

privacy.title: Data and privacy
body: CherryAI de-identifies service usage data, including AI conversations, so it cannot be used to identify you. CherryAI uses the resulting data only for product improvement and model training.
Avoid entering sensitive personal information such as government ID numbers, bank card numbers, passwords, detailed health information or your home address.
If you do not agree to these data uses, please stop subscribing to Cherry Flash.

goals.title: What we are aiming for
items: Make AI at work affordable enough that the price is no longer the barrier.
Provide reliable access to the best open-source Flash models for office work.
Curate models that have been tested and benchmarked on everyday office tasks.
No lock-in — you can keep using any other provider alongside Cherry Flash.

invoice.question: Can I get an invoice?
invoice.answer: To request an invoice, email your subscription account and billing information to <email>support@cherry-ai.com</email>.

cancel.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancel.answer: Yes. Canceling stops automatic renewal. You can continue using your remaining allowance until the end of the current billing cycle.

refund.question: Can I request a refund?
refund.answer: You may qualify for a refund if the charge was made within the past 14 days and you have not used any subscription allowance during that billing cycle. Contact <email>support@cherry-ai.com</email> to request a refund.

accounts.question: Do I need an account with each model provider?
accounts.answer: No. One subscription gives you access to the included models without signing up or adding funds with each provider separately.

cta.description: CNY 19.9 per month, with no separate accounts for each model.
